scope: Standard two-human module campaign through natural shared exhaustion, original continue menu and legal quit; not browser or full-eight-stage success acceptance
controls: Both humans hold right with 250ms refresh; after original continue menu, release, Select, release, Start through seat-specific module actions. Timer advances by 50ms.
noInterventions: No bot strategy or synthetic observer execution
limitations: Timer clock is accelerated in the module harness.
Ledger policy is covered separately by HTTP/SQLite boundary checks.
Synthetic visual asset configuration is unused because both seats remain human.
This verifies natural shared failure, not a natural victory or complete game acceptance.

recordedReplay.equality: Every remaining Session state equals the save/restored run, including terminal flush.
